Product Features

  • Inspired design, lasting appeal: open the doors to a world of classic sophistication with our curved drawer front cabinet. Each carefully crafted panel is a nod to architectural heritage and brings a touch of timeless style to your home.
  • Same-sized storage drawers: The six functional drawers with an internal volume of 13H/33B/51T cm allow you to sort clothes and other things. The inside of the drawers is also finished in cream white - a piece that shows attention to detail from the inside out. The generously sized drawers offer enough space to neatly store your belongings, out of sight but within reach!
  • Adjust the height of your furniture: The adjustable middle leg can help you adjust the level of your drawer dresser, it will not cause damage and scratches on your floors, keep the product feet away from the damp floor, effectively protect the feet and floor to keep it neat and beautiful.
  • Sturdy Construction: The dresser has been designed to be a durable piece of furniture, as it has been made from high-quality wood material and an excellent rail, all for comfortable use. Color Notes: Please note that the colors in the online images of the items on your home monitor may differ from the original colors.
  • Easy Assembly & Clear Instructions: It comes in 2 parts that are flat-packed so that it can be easily moved to the room of your choice. The detailed instructions provided will guide you through the assembly process, making it a stress-free experience!
